question: Does OpenObserve Cloud give any permanent free allowance, and which Middleware page is current? The OpenObserve pricing page and its June 2025 policy post say the Cloud free tier is discontinued and offer a 14-day trial, while the repository README still says the Cloud free tier includes up to 50 GB a day of ingestion. The Middleware pricing FAQ describes a 14-day trial with unlimited ingestion and 14 days of retention, while release 2.8.2 of 9 September 2026 introduces a Free Forever plan with 100 GB of ingestion that needs a credit card.
why: Two first-party sources disagree for each vendor; the new openobserve-cloud record is trial-only and the middleware record follows the newer release notes, and an account would settle both.
